children: Soybean futures are on track to snap an eight-session losing streak after the USDA reports solid weekly export sales. "Export sales remain red hot relative to recent years amid the resurgence of Chinese buying," Mike Castle of StoneX says in a note. The 104.4 million bushels for the week ended Oct. 16 "represent the largest print for any week since November 2023," he says. Cumulative 2026/27 soybean sales are their highest since 2022, he adds. The USDA also reported an additional 202,000 metric tons of flash sales to China. CBOT soybeans are up 0.7%. (anthony.harrup@wsj.com)
